title: A monk at the end of the tunnel
content:
I was ending a violent marriage. My husband punched me in the eye area and I fell down. He then strangled me, and I lost consciousness. Everything became smokey/cloudy. It was like I was in nothingness. I started to see light, and I understood that I had died. I was thrilled and said, "Oh, it's true. There IS life after death."

Then things became more focused. I was walking along a long winding path. There was a forest-like environment and in the far distance I could see a monastery. As I continued to walk, a being became visible. He was dressed in brown robe-like clothing with a belt. He raised his arms to greet me. As I came closer, I felt the excitement of reaching my destiny. However, as I was about to enter into his arms, he stopped me. He raised one hand and pointed his index finger at me and in very loud, very carefully spoken words said, "You must go back." It was like a flash. I felt like a vacuum was sucking me back into my body. I was aware only of my astral body until it hit and got back into my physical body. Instantly, I became aware/conscious. My response with my own mind were the words, "You bastard. You made me come back." I felt anger that I could not stay there; that I had to come back. Someone came to help me up, and I went to take care of myself. The experience is still vivid in my mind.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Everything became smokey/cloudy. It was like I was in nothingness.

arrival.other_being_detail: A being dressed in brown robe-like clothing with a belt (monk-like), who raised his arms to greet her and then stopped her and said, 'You must go back.'

environment.environment_other_detail: Long winding path; forest-like environment; monastery in the distance.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Felt 'like a vacuum was sucking me back into my body' and was aware of her 'astral body' until it 'hit and got back into' her physical body; instantaneous return to consciousness.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Strangulation during domestic violence; lost consciousness.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Smokey/cloudy nothingness shifting into a long winding path toward a distant monastery; greeted by a monk-like being who told her to go back; vacuum-like pull back into body.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Void/nothingness and light occurred before arrival into an earthlike environment (path/forest/monastery) and encounter with a being; then a verbal boundary and rapid return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Described being aware of her 'astral body' being pulled back 'like a vacuum' and 'hit' back into her physical body; monk-like figure at a monastery rather than a typical 'being of light.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "Oh, it's true. There IS life after death."; "You must go back."; "You bastard. You made me come back."
